title: cbuild_picture
description: A kit's picture settings, stored in the _cbuild_picture product meta. A kit with none draws the layers in the usual order and guesses a missing wheelbase from the deck's shape.

schema_version.description: The document's version. Version 1 is the only one so far.

order.description: Slot keys from the bottom of the picture's stack to the top, each once. A slot left out is drawn after these in the usual order: deck, grip, trucks, wheels. A key the kit has no slot for is passed over.

wheelbase.description: Where the trucks sit on a deck that gives no wheelbase: inches between the inner holes, as a decimal in text from 10 to 20. Empty or left out, the usual for the deck's shape.
